measurements.metric_kind: prefill throughput = input_len / prefill_wall_s (9-token golden prompt, 43 layers)
measurements.milestone: FIRST DeepSeek-V4-family model run on Trainium2 native PyTorch (284B MoE: MLA + Hyper-Connections + Compressed/Sparse attention + 256-expert FP4 MoE).
measurements.best_config: eager, single-process (world=1), MoE ON-DEVICE via static-shape dispatch, fp4/fp8 dequant-on-device
measurements.baseline_config: reference forward with MoE offloaded to CPU (the reference MoE's data-dependent torch.where gather DEADLOCKS the Neuron runtime at 43L, so it cannot run on-device)
measurements.baseline_provenance: DOCUMENTED prior measurement (examples/deepseek_v4/flash/GOLDEN_VALIDATION.md, trn2.48xl box2, cold). Cross-run baseline, clearly labelled; NOT self-measured this session. The core self-measured claim is the on-device forward (argmax 671, 310.7s) on bigsweep2 2026-09-01.
measurements.core_contribution: on-device MoE enablement: static-shape expert dispatch (no torch.where gather) runs the 256-expert MoE entirely on-device (77.1% of compute) with no runtime deadlock and no CPU offload.
measurements.forward_breakdown: MoE 202.8s (77.1%, 43 calls) / attention 60.3s (22.9%: CSA 36.4s over 21, HCA 3.6s over 20, SWA 20.3s over 2)
measurements.correctness: argmax=671 at the 9-token golden prompt, MATCHING the prior functional trn2 port. vs the 8xH100 golden (argmax 51119 'Paris'): cosine 0.9808 = compounded fp8/fp4 dequant quant-noise over 86 ops (per-op cos 0.99997+), a KNOWN precision effect, not a port bug. Bit-exact argmax needs bit-exact FP4/FP8 NKI kernels.
measurements.honest_caveats: Single-process eager (not yet TP/EP-parallel: prior TP+EP=8 = 59s @ 43L is the documented throughput next-step). Prefill wall is conservatively measured with per-op device sync (rule #2). Functional (argmax 671), not bit-exact (51119). Top optimization levers unclaimed: FP4-in-kernel storage (3.72x, one MLIR verifier fix away), MTP speculative decode (~1.8x), pure-EP world=32.
measurements.gate: verified functional forward: finite logits, argmax=671 reproduces the prior golden; on-device MoE (no deadlock). speedup 1.43x is on-device static-MoE vs reference CPU-offload (documented baseline).
